title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the Deduction of Advance Payments for Goods by Banks and Credit Cooperatives to Recover Loans Should Be Refunded

articles.content_en:
4. Where a bank, credit cooperative, or other financial institution makes an acceptance to the prepayer to use the funds for specific purposes but withholds the funds to repay loans, the prepayer may also directly request the bank, credit cooperative, or other financial institution to return the prepaid goods money that it has withheld.
March 9, 1994
